tool.name: Trapiche
tool.description: classify a metagenomic sample by biome from its description

param.name: description_data
param.label: Sample or study description
param.help: Select a plain-text Galaxy dataset containing the description used to predict the biome.

param.name: model_files
param.label: Trapiche model files
param.help: Select all required Trapiche text and vector model files. Keep their original downloaded or prepared filenames so the tool can place them in the required model layout.

validator.message: Use letters, numbers, periods, underscores, or hyphens only.

tool.help:
**What it does**
Trapiche predicts the biome represented by a metagenomic sample using its study description. The tool runs the container's ``trapiche-galaxy --mode text`` workflow and verifies the required model files before inference.
The CPU runtime and model artifacts are documented by BioAIrepo study ``S-BAIR13``. The local image is derived from the study's released Trapiche 1.1.4 Linux AMD64 runtime and is pinned to its registry digest.
Select a plain-text description dataset and all required Trapiche text and vector model files from the Galaxy history. The defaults reproduce sample ID ``sample-001`` and four CPU threads from the documented invocation.
**Administrator requirement**
The selected model files are staged inside the isolated job working directory according to their filenames. Both original download names such as ``text_classifier_model_1.0.safetensors`` and prepared names such as ``model_1.0.safetensors`` are accepted. Text mode requires the six executable files from ``text/1.0`` and all six files from ``vector/1.0``; the text model-card README and the approximately 10 GB taxonomy model are not required. Trapiche verifies every selected runtime asset against the study's sizes and checksums before inference.
The tool produces the prediction record, reproducibility provenance (including checksums and runtime information), and the Trapiche execution log.
